title: AI Short Dramas Bid Farewell to Wild Growth: WeChat to Require Submission of Full-Process Proof Videos for AI Generation Starting in December
excerpt: On November 20, the WeChat Short Drama Content Center issued an announcement, announcing two important adjustments to the platform's short drama review standard
content_html:
On November 20, the WeChat Short Drama Content Center issued an announcement, announcing two important adjustments to the platform's short drama review standards. The new rules will officially take effect on December 1, 2026, aiming to further standardize the management of AI-generated content and improve the overall quality of short dramas.

The first adjustment targets the content duration threshold. The platform will raise the minimum duration of a single short drama episode from the original 45 seconds to 1 minute. After the new rules take effect, episodes less than 1 minute long will not pass submission review. This move is intended to guide creators to focus on the coherence and completeness of each episode's narrative, avoid rushed plots and fragmented storylines caused by overly short runtimes, and thereby improve the viewing experience for end users.

On the AI content compliance front, WeChat has added an "AI Production Proof Video" submission requirement for episodes containing AI-generated content. This material is currently optional and will officially become mandatory starting December 1. According to the rules, the proof video must fully show the process by which the creator used AI software to generate content, specifically covering the asset list, episode list, prompts corresponding to different episodes and storyboards, and playback footage of a small number of storyboard clips. It supports formats such as PDF, JPG, PNG, and MP4 (single file no larger than 10 MB, up to 3 uploads).

As generative AI rapidly penetrates the field of micro short drama production, hidden risks such as material misappropriation and unclear copyright ownership are gradually emerging. By introducing prompt and project asset verification mechanisms, WeChat can effectively confirm the originality and authenticity of episodes, reduce review rejections caused by missing project files, and while improving platform review efficiency, also drive the AI short drama industry toward a more standardized and premium direction.
